The `decovton` package is from Levinna/DeCo-VTON:
https://github.com/Levinna/DeCo-VTON

Source commit: c7a1caa79a9af3f881ff5004624057176f973ab2
The pipeline loader was extended with a `local_files_only` option for offline
startup. Its license is included as `DECO-VTON-LICENSE`.
Model weights are downloaded separately and are not included in the source archive.
